description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="User">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectAndShowValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Begin inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineDetails" name="Enter machine type and serial number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press inspection buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndShowValues" name="Collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions required?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDetails" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetailsToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToButtons" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonsToCollection" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectionToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${resultsRequireAdditionalQuestions}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalAnswersToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
